findings.causalAssessment: A formerly current-profile test constant was retained after accepted HS03 introduced W and explicit historical profile selection. The test conflates the implementation currently reading with the immutable profile of the history being read. The support helper only supplies pinned inputs; it performs no migration or compatibility selection.
findings.triggerProbability: Certain for these exact inputs if the first case reaches line67; second current-profile cold read necessarily cannot satisfy the historical-profile equality (earlier lawful refusal remains possible).
findings.realizedHarm: This setup blocks two exact large-history regression/performance claims. No current Product runtime defect or unlawful sunny-day execution is established; no log, Product archive or runtime authority changes.
findings.blastRadius: Exactly the named first two consolidation cases in this review. Later file cases and broader execution are neither waived nor audited here. All three reviewed test/support files are unchanged from RC7 local bytes and absent from the 5325-member archive.
findings.failClosedContainment: Explicit first-case assertion and the real cold-reader profile guard prevent stale data from becoming current-profile truth. Byte/hash, device/inode, length and profile checks must remain.
findings.repairComplexity: Low: one unshipped test file, first two cases’ coordinate construction and their historical-profile input binding only; a few statements, no Product algorithm, shared-helper change, build, new baseline or archive recut. Proof runtime may be minutes due to 586 MB cold history and existing 600-second per-case limits; no measured duration estimate is invented.
findings.regressionRisk: Low if only profile selection changes and all assertions/canonical input bytes remain exact. High risk if repaired by restamping, dropping mismatch checks, replacing expected context with candidate output, skipping cases, altering work bounds or accepting current-profile fallback.
findings.confidence: High for stale coordinate selection and lawful refusal; indeterminate for the later unexecuted exact large-log context and cost assertions.
